title: Hexa character pack
description: A character for Hexa: a skeleton, vector parts on its bones, verlet chains (hair, cables), a palette and visor glyphs. Validated at load time by src/renderer/js/character/pack.js. Coordinates are design pixels, y negative upward, relative to the parent bone.

height.description: Design height in px at scale 1.

bones.description: In order: every bone's parent comes before it; the first bone is the root (parent null).

pose.description: Pose field (see acting.js NEUTRAL) that sets this bone's angle, in radians.

sign.description: -1 mirrors the pose field, for the right side.

stretch.description: Pose field that scales this bone along its length (children keep their size).

fold.description: Foreshortened by pose.fold (thighs toward the viewer when sitting).

path.description: SVG path data in the bone's space, absolute M L C Q Z only.

fill.description: A palette key, 'emblem' (her state colour) or 'none'.

role.description: Parts the renderer draws extra things on.

angle.description: Rest direction relative to the bone, radians; 0 hangs down.

plug.description: Draw a plug at the end (her cable).

glyphs.description: Visor expressions: two 5×5 grids (left eye, right eye) of '.' and '#'. Required: calm, smug, wide, laugh, squint, sleepy, angry, dizzy, heart, loading, ask, dead.
